title: VideoLights: Feature Refinement and Cross-Task Alignment Transformer for Joint Video Highlight Detection and Moment Retrieval

problems.name: Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment Gap
problems.evidence_sentence: To overcome these limitations, we propose VideoLights, a unified framework that holistically integrates cross-modal and crosstask dynamics to advance joint video highlight detection and moment retrieval.
